notes: Dense windows are used for model training so the conditional model sees richer center-frequency and width variation.
Only a curated subset of bands is exposed in the application-facing layer to keep the output interpretable and aligned with engineering use cases.

bands.label: Low-Frequency Sparse
bands.reason: Useful when the goal is to find rare structures that can open a low-frequency gap.

bands.label: Mid-Band Core
bands.reason: This window has strong structure-frequency interaction and is a good default engineering target.

bands.label: Mid-Band Wide
bands.reason: Useful when a wider acceptable operating band is preferred over a narrow center window.

bands.label: Mid-Band Envelope
bands.reason: Captures whether a design supports a robust band gap across a larger mid-band span.

bands.label: Upper-Mid Band
bands.reason: Useful when the target application wants a slightly higher working band than the core mid-band window.

bands.label: Upper-Mid Narrow
bands.reason: Provides a more selective upper-mid check than the wider 200-260 envelope.

bands.label: High-Frequency Sparse
bands.reason: Useful when only a small fraction of structures are expected to satisfy the high-frequency target.
